content: it-tools architecture (verified against raw source): Tool interface = {name, path, description, keywords[], component: () => Promise<Component> (lazy), icon: Component (sync), redirectFrom?, isNew (auto-computed from createdAt via defineTool wrapper)}. Each tool is a self-contained dir: index.ts (defineTool), tool.vue, tool.service.ts (pure logic), unit + e2e tests; scaffold script creates dir and inserts import. Central registry src/tools/index.ts exports toolsByCategory / flat tools / toolsWithCategory. Router generates tool routes from that registry: component field (lazy import) becomes route component, tool.path becomes route path, meta.layout=toolLayout, redirectFrom becomes redirect routes, wildcard 404 last. Home page imported statically (LCP-critical), other pages lazy. Consumers of registry: router, search, store, cards.
